about: What each class's trainer spells and talents are worth, from articles and class guides (CC-847). value: core (train it the moment it's out), useful (train at the next town visit) or minor (can wait). A core tier's kind: class (every spec wants it) or spec (one spec, named in spec). Each tier names the article it comes from (source) and why. others: what other sources said, where they differ. A spell no source names is left out. tools/build_class_spells.py merges this into data/classspells.json.
